meta.title: Mahayana Bodhisattva Realization
meta.description: Draw passages from the Holy Light teachings. A floating Xiao Guang recites short passages at a configurable random interval; a macOS desktop companion window floats above all apps and stays visible when DSH is minimized. A left-sidebar page holds Study, a practice journal, and Ask Xiao Guang, a memory agent whose dharma answers quote the original text verbatim.
